title: International Society of Sports Nutrition position stand: nutrient timing
publisher: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition
claims: For extended bouts of high-intensity exercise longer than 60 minutes, carbohydrate should be consumed at about 30-60 grams per hour in a 6-8% carbohydrate-electrolyte solution every 10-15 minutes.
Carbohydrate intake during exercise should be practiced and adjusted to the individual and the event.
When carbohydrate delivery is inadequate, adding protein may help performance and recovery, but it does not replace adequate carbohydrate.
